study_design: paired pretreatment and post-treatment HNSCC bulk RNA-seq after two nivolumab doses, with or without tadalafil
response_blind_filter: CPM >= 1 in at least 6 of 56 samples
orientation_rationale: all frozen modules encode positive post-treatment remodeling; deeper pathological response was hypothesized before GSE195832 scoring to accompany greater post-minus-pre induction
primary_model: family post-minus-pre delta ~ ordinal response + tadalafil arm + sequencing batch, OLS with HC3 covariance
permutation_scheme: ordinal response labels permuted within treatment arm; tadalafil arm and batch remain fixed
random_family_null: one unique non-locked expression-decile-matched replacement per measured locked gene, inheriting every original module membership
global_pc_gene_universe: filtered non-locked genes with non-zero paired-delta variance
age_exclusion_reason: source metadata reports age 5 for TJU033; no unsourced correction is permitted
